result.instructions: Tools for Action1, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our endpoints are offline or still need a reboot?"; "List the missing critical updates across all organizations, grouped by endpoint."; "Which endpoints are affected by CVE-2021-44228, and is it on the CISA KEV list?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Action1 data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run action1_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run action1_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run action1_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. action1_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: action1_list_organizations
tools.title: List organizations
tools.description: List the Action1 organizations these API credentials can reach, with their ids. Call this first: most other tools need an organization id. Action1 API: GET /organizations.

admin.description: true = only organizations where the credentials are at least an organization admin.

tools.name: action1_get_current_user
tools.title: Get the API user
tools.description: Get the settings and roles of the user behind these API credentials. Use it to check what the credentials can see. Action1 API: GET /me.

tools.name: action1_search
tools.title: Search Action1
tools.description: Search endpoints, software and other Action1 objects in one organization by text. Action1 API: GET /search/{orgId}.

tools.name: action1_list_endpoints
tools.title: List managed endpoints
tools.description: List the managed endpoints (computers) of one organization or of all organizations, with status, OS, last-seen time and update state. Filter by status, update state, OS or reboot need. Action1 API: GET /endpoints/managed/{orgId}.

orgId.description: Organization id from action1_list_organizations, or 'all' (default) for every organization these credentials can reach.

from.description: Number of the first record to return (paging).

sortby.description: Sort field. Prefix with '-' for descending, e.g. '-name'.

filter.description: Case-insensitive text. Keeps records where any field contains it.

reboot_required.description: Only endpoints that need a reboot (Yes) or not (No).

os.description: Operating system filter, as Action1 names it (for example Windows 11).

fields.description: Extra detail. 'missing_updates' or 'vulnerabilities' adds counts (slower). '*' adds all of them.

tools.name: action1_get_endpoint
tools.title: Get a managed endpoint
tools.description: Get one managed endpoint: name, OS, hardware, agent version, last seen and status. Action1 API: GET /endpoints/managed/{orgId}/{endpointId}.

orgId.description: Organization id from action1_list_organizations, or 'all' (default) for every organization these credentials can reach.

tools.name: action1_list_endpoint_groups
tools.title: List endpoint groups

from.description: Number of the first record to return (paging).

sortby.description: Sort field. Prefix with '-' for descending, e.g. '-name'.

filter.description: Case-insensitive text. Keeps records where any field contains it.

tools.title: List endpoints in a group

from.description: Number of the first record to return (paging).

sortby.description: Sort field. Prefix with '-' for descending, e.g. '-name'.

filter.description: Case-insensitive text. Keeps records where any field contains it.

reboot_required.description: Only endpoints that need a reboot (Yes) or not (No).

os.description: Operating system filter, as Action1 names it (for example Windows 11).

tools.name: action1_list_missing_updates
tools.title: List missing updates
tools.description: List the software updates (patches) that endpoints still miss, across one organization or all organizations. Filter by approval status and severity. Action1 API: GET /updates/{orgId}.

orgId.description: Organization id from action1_list_organizations, or 'all' (default) for every organization these credentials can reach.

from.description: Number of the first record to return (paging).

sortby.description: Sort field. Prefix with '-' for descending, e.g. '-name'.

filter.description: Case-insensitive text. Keeps records where any field contains it.

security_severity.description: Security severity. '-Critical' means every severity except Critical.

custom.description: true = only custom packages, false = only built-in packages.

tools.title: List updates for a package
tools.description: List the updates of one software package and the endpoints they affect. Action1 API: GET /updates/{orgId}/{packageId}.

orgId.description: Organization id from action1_list_organizations, or 'all' (default) for every organization these credentials can reach.

packageId.description: Software package id from action1_list_package_updates or action1_list_missing_updates.

from.description: Number of the first record to return (paging).

sortby.description: Sort field. Prefix with '-' for descending, e.g. '-name'.

filter.description: Case-insensitive text. Keeps records where any field contains it.

security_severity.description: Security severity. '-Critical' means every severity except Critical.

from.description: Number of the first record to return (paging).

filter.description: Case-insensitive text. Keeps records where any field contains it.

tools.name: action1_list_reports
tools.title: List reports
tools.description: List the Action1 report definitions available to these credentials (built-in and custom). Use the report ids with action1_get_report_rows. Action1 API: GET /reports/all.
